summary.headline: Birlasoft Q1 FY27 revenue flat in dollars at $145.2M (+0.3% cc QoQ) with TCV up 20% YoY to $168.7M and EBITDA margin at 16.1%.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue was $145.2M, flat in dollar terms and +0.3% QoQ in constant currency, while rupee revenue rose 2.3% QoQ to INR1,379.4 crore. EBITDA was INR222 crore (+40.3% YoY) at a 16.1% margin, which management said is normalised after the ~170 bps one-off tailwind in Q4 FY26. TCV signings of $168.7M were up 20% YoY, with several AI-led wins, though QoQ signings fell from the prior quarter. Management guided to a wage-hike hit in Q2 but declined to give full-year numeric guidance.

financial_highlights.change: flat QoQ in USD; +0.3% QoQ constant currency
+40.3% YoY; Q4 FY26 had ~170 bps one-off tailwind
ETR 29.4%, up QoQ as Q4 had tax concession benefit

segments.name: BFSI (Financial Services)
segments.commentary: Sequential growth in BFSI helped offset softness; management expects Financial Services to do well for the year despite furlough-related Q3 risk.

segments.name: LSS (Life Sciences & Healthcare)
segments.commentary: Sequential growth in LSS; management expects LSS to bounce back and won a Gen AI pharmacovigilance engagement with a leading pharma/medtech company.

segments.name: Manufacturing
segments.commentary: Revenue softness continued; management says weakness persists for some time, with a couple of quarters needed to recover and a structural issue being addressed.

segments.name: Energy & Utilities (E&U)
segments.commentary: Softness expected for one more quarter; management expects a turnaround from Q3 FY27.

guidance_outlook: Management will not give full-year guidance; says H1 FY27 deal signings will be better than H1 FY26 and full-year signings should exceed FY26.
Management expects momentum to carry into Q2 FY27 but declined to quantify revenue growth; 2 months of Q1 remained at the time of the call.
EBITDA margin: management continues to target 15%-plus, expecting ~15% or slightly better net of investments.
Wage hike effective July 1, 2026 for all associates; full impact 170-200 bps, about half hitting Q2 P&L, with productivity expected to recover much of it.
FY27 effective tax rate expected at 29%-30%.
capex_capacity: Sales team expansion underway; management expects a substantial increase in sales headcount over the next quarter or so, with sales/domain/service-line headcount up and support headcount trimmed.
Investment in Cogito AI platform (orchestration), LynX test engineering platform and Sigma AIOps/AMS platform; Cogito MVP shown to 15+ clients.
Capability-based inorganic moves considered only if strategic; management prioritises 3-4 quarters of sequential organic growth first.
demand_pricing: TCV of $168.7M up 20% YoY vs Q1 FY26 (~$140M); management noted QoQ TCV lower than Q3/Q4 FY26 ($200M+ each). Net new bookings up ~$15M YoY.
Deal tenures 18-24 months; no short-term projects; many deals now carry an AI component.
Competition is fierce; most deals are contested, though Birlasoft is winning its fair share.

Pricing pressure is significant as AI-driven productivity is being passed to clients on renewals and new deals, creating a gap between TCV and revenue that management expects to close over 3-4 quarters.
Renewals are being protected with no losses cited.
Active clients ~213 (down QoQ due to rationalisation, management says now done); top 36 accounts contribute ~80% of business; top 5/10/20/30 accounts grew QoQ.
Unbilled revenue at March 2026 was higher than expected due to delayed client documentation; billing regularised and collections improved in Q1.

qa_highlights.question: How confident is management on sustaining cc QoQ growth, and what is the vertical demand trend?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects momentum to sustain; Financial Services and LSS to stay strong, Manufacturing weak for longer, and E&U softness for one more quarter with turnaround from Q3.

qa_highlights.question: Quantify the wage hike impact and whether it is phased.
qa_highlights.answer: Full-year impact 170-200 bps, about half in Q2 FY27, applied in full from July 1 with no phasing; productivity expected to recover much of it.

qa_highlights.question: Will the TCV-to-revenue gap close and when?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited pricing pressure from AI productivity pass-through; expects TCV to convert into revenue over the next 3-4 quarters as the industry stabilises.

qa_highlights.question: Capital allocation plans for ~INR2,879 crore cash?
qa_highlights.answer: Board will reward shareholders and deploy cash in organic or capability-based inorganic growth; no acquisition for revenue aggregation; buyback or policy not announced.

qa_highlights.question: Why is unbilled revenue high and fixed-price revenue down?
qa_highlights.answer: Delayed documentation with two clients delayed billing; now regularised with collections up. Management continues working to reduce unbilled.

qa_highlights.question: Will H1 FY27 deal signings and client count bottom out?
qa_highlights.answer: H1 FY27 signings expected to exceed H1 FY26; active accounts ~213 with rationalisation done; account count expected to rise in 1-2 quarters as new sales hires build real estate.

risks_watch: Revenue growth remains near flat; sustaining QoQ cc growth in Q2 FY27 is unproven.
Q2 FY27 margin dilution from wage hike (170-200 bps full impact, ~half in Q2) before productivity offsets.
Manufacturing and E&U (together near 50% of revenue per analyst) remain weak; recovery timing is uncertain.
AI-driven pricing pressure could widen the gap between TCV and revenue.
Unbilled revenue elevated; watch for reduction in subsequent quarters.
No numeric guidance; investors pressed for quantified signings and client metrics and a formal capital allocation policy. Cash of INR2,879 crore unallocated.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the order book and AI wins but cautious on revenue: management repeatedly declined numeric guidance and said Manufacturing and E&U need a couple of quarters. Capital allocation answers were non-committal, deferring to the Board.
key_quotes: We believe that from here on, we should be looking to sustain the momentum.
The deal tenures are long term. There is no short-term project.
But first, Amit, I have to get the company to deliver quarter-on-quarter organic growth.

growth.why: No full-year revenue guidance given; USD revenue flat QoQ at $145.2M and TCV up 20% YoY to $168.7M with AI-led wins, but management said H1 signings should beat H1 FY26 without numeric backing, while pricing pressure and manufacturing softness persist, and margin target of 15%-plus is held.
